g.text: J2 -> E03 J3 pins 4/5/6. J3 -> E02 J5 pins 1/2. K3 released=Master, energized=Send/Return.

g.text: Second gain coil/input-range contacts are external. ALL FOUR audio rails must qualify E02 ANALOG_OK. Firmware switches gain while dry.
